articles.title: Inside The Two Argentinas Under Javier Milei
articles.raw_summary:
President Javier Milei has brought inflation down and opened Argentina to more investment, helping fuel a boom in energy and other export industries. But manufacturing, retail and small businesses are struggling, leaving many Argentines feeling that the recovery is passing them by. One year before the election, Milei’s biggest test may be unifying an increasingly fragmented economy.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Halloween Candy Prices Reflect Cocoa’s Wild Ride
articles.raw_summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Ignacio Canalas Polo explains why chocolate and Halloween candy remain expensive even after cocoa prices retreated from their peaks, pointing to persistent supply pressures in Ivory Coast and Ghana and manufacturers’ efforts to manage costs. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Polo says consumers may see more promotions, but structurally higher cocoa costs and product reformulation mean chocolate prices are unlikely to return quickly to previous levels. (Source: Bloomberg)
